I'm ready to fight my sister now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}To bring my sister back to her senses, I have to fight...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Even if it costs me my life, I have to defeat the fallen angel controlling her...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I think that's my mission now...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}A hero who fell under a fallen angel's spell is tormenting people.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I want to try to talk them around, but their heart seems to be completely closed. All I can do now is ask you...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Turning a blade on you... What a troublesome hero.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, fine. I'll lend you my strength. One swing of my sword might wake them up.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}The enemy is a former hero... Are you really all right with that?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Understood. I'll head there now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}The enemy's a hero... What's that supposed to mean?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Makes no sense to me, but I'll go anyway. Hope they're the type ya can talk to.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You have... talked it over with them thoroughly, I take it?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Very well. Leave the rest to me. I will go and face them.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}A former hero as the enemy... I never thought that could happen...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'll try going. I hope they're someone I can talk to.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}A former hero as the enemy... I don't really want to believe it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}...Okay. I'll go anyway. Maybe we can talk once I'm there.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}The enemy's a former hero... I don't know what happened, but what a mess, really.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Fine. If you'll have me, I'll go. I just hope it ends peacefully...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}A former hero as the enemy... That's weird. Did you do something weird again?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, fine. I'll go right away. But let this be the last time, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}That guy... used to be a hero, right? Picking a fight with you, what a weird personality.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Whatever. I'll teach 'em a lesson. Leave it to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I see... Things have gotten serious.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Anyway, I'll lend you a hand. So don't you worry about it. You did everything you could.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I understand. I'll do everything I can. If there's a choice, the best way...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2980}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sorry, but I'm not inclined this time. If it's a hero you chose, can't you get through to them with a little persuasion?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Try talking to them first. If that fails... good grief, then I suppose it's my turn.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Are you sure? Think it over once more. I'll go after that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What's that? Your own underling turned on ya?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Not my problem. Clean up your own mess.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I don't mind going, but are you sure about this? They were a hero just like us, I'm told...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Once you are truly satisfied, I will accept the request. Until then, please let me hold my answer.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I'm sorry... I don't think I could fight someone who used to be a hero.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I get it, but... are you really okay with this? They were a hero once, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}If you can, I'd like you to think it over once more. If there's really nothing else to do, then I'll go next time for sure.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}A former hero, right? Honestly, how about reaping what you sowed yourself?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Sorry, but I'll pass. I don't want something that leaves a bad taste.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Getting betrayed by a hero... you must have done something really bad, huh?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Clean up your own mess. Or ask somebody else. Something that leaves such a bad taste? I pass!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}That's the one who flunked as a hero, right? I don't feel like taking on somebody who got kicked out.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sorry, but try somebody else. I don't have time to deal with someone like that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Are you really all right with that? Think it over once, at least.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Um... Angel, isn't there any other way?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry to be selfish. But I think, if you can, you should talk with that hero once more.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}A former hero as the enemy... That's weird. Did you do something weird again?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, fine. I'll go right away. But let this be the last time, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I understand. I don't know how much I can do, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm a hero too, sort of, so I'll try my very best.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I understand. But... would you let me decline this one?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Someone as weak as me could never fight monsters. Please ask someone else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I see... They've always been doing that sort of thing. It might be good to teach them a little lesson.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}It seems lots of people are unhappy with them, too... I'll try, in my own way.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I see, I understand the situation. But I'm sorry. I already have something important to do.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}It hurts to think of the people being troubled, but... please let me pass this time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I understand. I may not be able to do much, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'll do my best to live up to your hopes, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1F80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}F-fighting monsters...?! How am I supposed to fight things like that...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}There's no way I could. Angel, couldn't you ask someone else to handle it?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I understand. As a hero, I can't lose to the powers of darkness.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I don't know how far I'll get, but I'll do all I can.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I understand, Angel. I can't leave alone bad people who use force to make the weak cry.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Let's show them that strength isn't everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I understand, but... I'm sorry. Could you let me think about this a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I don't think holding people down by force solves anything. Please give me a little more time to think.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I understand, Angel. I don't know if someone like me stands a chance against magic, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}We can't just leave it, can we? I'll do the best I can.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I understand, but... that's just impossible, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Against someone who uses magic, I don't think I'd stand a chance. Please try someone else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I understand. If I hurry, I can still make it, right? I'm off, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Don't worry. Leave it to me. I'm a hero too, sort of.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I see. But... would I make it in time if I left now?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}With that kind of incident, won't the knights be the first to rush there? I think it'd be better to wait and see.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, I understand. That sort of thing doesn't bother me, you know. Hm? Surprised?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}It'll be fine. I'll solve it properly, you'll see.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5B80}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I understand. But that kind of thing is often just a rumor...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}So could you wait and see a little longer?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I understand, Angel. I'll find the source of the calamity and settle it properly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}No need to worry. I'm a hero too, sort of.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I understand. But honestly, I'm not very keen on it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Could we wait and see a little longer?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So I just have to bring it back. I understand, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I hope I can live up to your hopes... I'll do all I can.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7980}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Angel, couldn't we leave fetching it for another time?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm worried we won't be around when things get really bad... I'm sorry to be selfish.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It's a strange sort of case... but it sounds interesting. I understand. I'll give it a try.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}It sounds kind of fun, so I'll do all I can.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I'm sorry. It looks easy to solve, but actually I'm a bit tied up right now...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}I'm sorry, but please make it another time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
